topic: Shubhanshu Shukla Indian flag on ISS
hook: Your Indian flag went to the space station in 2025.
title: An Indian Flag Floated Inside the ISS
description:
In June 2025, Shubhanshu Shukla launched on the Axiom-4 mission and became the first Indian on the International Space Station. He carried the Indian flag with him. Part of the If You Were in Space series.

#Shorts #ShubhanshuShukla #ISS
